risks.risk: Whether it is fully functional (printing/copying/scanning) and whether there are active errors.
risks.proof: A short video or clip showing the machine powered on with no error codes, plus a test print/copy (preferably colour) from the control panel.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst case: needs service/unknown faults).

risks.risk: Toner/consumables condition (toner levels, drum/transfer belt life) affecting print quality and cost to restore.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of toner/drum status screens (or the consumables indicators) and a printed test page showing colour density.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if consumables may be low/near end-of-life (worst case: may require replacement).

risks.risk: Paper handling issues (feeders, trays, duplex unit) and jams.
risks.proof: A clip printing a multi-page job from the main tray with duplex enabled, showing no jams and successful finishing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if paper path/duplex may be unreliable (worst case: limited to basic feeding).

risks.risk: Missing options/accessories (e.g., finisher, extra trays, network/scan options) that change value.
risks.proof: Photos of all included trays/attachments and the back/side ports; show what accessories are present (and what is not).
risks.if_unproven: Price as base unit only (worst case: missing add-ons).

risks.risk: Counter/usage level (high mileage can mean higher wear).
risks.proof: Photo of the machine’s total counter/usage page from the settings menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as high-usage (worst case) until counter is shown.

proof_requests: Power-on photo/video showing no error codes on the screen.
A colour test print (multi-page) and a scan/copy demonstration (video preferred).
Close-up photo of toner/consumables status (or the status screen).
Photos of all included trays/attachments and back ports (to confirm options).
response.reason: The model is readable in the photo (Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e). However, functional status, consumables, and options are not proven, so the item should be priced at the worst case using the closest comparables for Konica Minolta bizhub MFP/copiers.
